g.text: Reduction in resting blood pressure vs control, by exercise mode. 270 RCTs, 15,827 participants (Edwards et al., BJSM 2023).

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #626a73

g.text: Solid bars: systolic. Outlined bars: diastolic. SUCRA = probability-based rank for systolic reduction (100% = certainly best).

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #626a73

g.text: Within isometric training, the wall squat ranked first for systolic reduction, ahead of leg extension and handgrip.
